description: For the people who map bike lanes, cycle tracks and routes. Every road is drawn by its TILDA category, and each side gets a section that says what is missing and how to tag it.
highlights: Roads coloured by bicycle infrastructure, with a TILDA section per side
Side paths: move sidewalk tags to the separate way, or extract a side
Traffic sign field and a way table for the ways along a street
Reroute a bicycle or hiking route; load osmChange files
